notes.subject: fix(terminal): echo multi-line native commands with CRLF to avoid staircase rendering
notes.summary: Multi-line native terminal commands now echo with CRLF line endings, so they no longer render as a staircase in the terminal.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): prevent helper downgrades during restart
notes.summary: Browser gateway restarts and startups are serialized with a lock and no longer downgrade a newer running helper; restarting from an older window now reports a clear error instead of replacing it.

notes.subject: fix(openai-compatible): give each response stream a unique thinking ID
notes.summary: Thinking blocks from OpenAI-compatible providers now get a unique ID per response, so thinking after a tool round appears as a new block instead of being appended to the first one.
